//: Tina's colour calls. lib/colour.ts reads this BEFORE its own vocabulary, so an entry here always wins. Written by the review page that scripts/colour-review.mjs generates; safe to hand-edit. Same role as data/colour-leads.json and data/default-cut-brands.json. A null value means 'this is not a colour' and is a real decision, not a gap - it stops the term coming back on the next review.
//terms: Keyed by the EXACT lowercased colourway suffix - the text after the ' - ' or inside the '(...)' at the end of a title, as lib/colorVariants.ts splits it. One entry fixes every row any brand ever names that way, including rows the nightly refresh has not added yet. The value is a colour family from lib/colour.ts (black grey white cream beige brown navy blue green yellow orange red pink purple multi) or null for 'not a colour'.
//weakWords: Keyed by a SINGLE lowercased word, and applies only to a match found in the BODY of a title, never in the suffix. It exists so a word like 'rose' can be switched off where it is usually a style name ('Mystic Rose Hijab') while still working as a colourway ('... - Dusty Rose'). null switches the word off in the body; a family name forces that family instead.
